description: One bug by id, the row as the daemon sees it. The two states ride as two fields (D2, R4): validation is a four-value machine (here reproduced, the attempt landed a definitive verdict), priority is a separate three-value set (here known with a label). `duplicateOf` and `roadmapItemId` render the honest absence (null, not zero) when unset. `validated` is the derived fact: not `unvalidated`.

result.title: retry counter over-counts on the second attempt
result.body: the retry counter adds two on the second attempt; expected one
